Two transient account failures reproduced loss of the loaded wallet. The new central gate preserves the same owner's wallet while suspending financial actions. Owner and action generations prevent interrupted preparation, reviews, batches and signing from resuming after recovery. Exchange funding is suppressed during a pause; trade and bridge status remain visible. The older Sell All browser test is consolidated into the new account matrix with an explicit coverage mapping.

Keep the first review and original red logs unchanged. Re-run affected checks and review on the newly frozen combination; exact-commit hosted CI and deployment/live acceptance follow.
